_comment: Fragment 56 — D-102: the merge gate may not exist, the control layer had a false green, and Verified was the answering lane's own word. Covers B-013 through B-018 and C-001. Merged 2026-08-24.

nodes.label: D-102 — The Gate That May Not Exist, and the Word That Was Not Earned
nodes.description: Seven entries answered in one pass. The live branch rule may target no branches at all, both channel checks read the next line as a missing field's value, and ten entries carried a verification word that the answering lane had written for itself.
nodes.rationale: Six of the seven entries report defects in the preceding decision or in the uncommitted pass repairing it. Recording that ratio rather than narrating it away is what makes the pattern visible as a structural property rather than a run of bad luck.

nodes.label: The Merge Gate May Not Be In Force
nodes.description: The live branch ruleset is reported as targeting zero branches through a malformed include string, and as carrying no required-status-check rule at all. The operative record says the protected branch requires a pull request and a passing check before merge.
nodes.rationale: Renaming a required context inside a rule that gates nothing changes nothing. Repairing the rule is the parent task and the rename is its child, which inverts the order the previous condition assumed.

nodes.label: An Authoritative Claim Nobody Can Reproduce
nodes.description: The live-settings finding is confirmed by the Chief Editor, and its evidence is a local file and screenshots that are not in the repository. The claim is authoritative and not reproducible by a later reader.
nodes.rationale: The record it corrects has exactly the same shape: it was asserted and never verified. Accepting the correction on the same footing would repeat the pattern one level up, so the evidence gap is recorded as a condition rather than closed by assertion.

nodes.label: The Parser Read the Next Line as a Missing Value
nodes.description: Both channel checks matched a metadata field with a whitespace class that includes the newline, so a blank field captured the following metadata line as its value. Three entries shipped with blank routing fields and the check reported a pass on all three.
nodes.rationale: This is not a checking gap but a checking lie: every claim the apparatus makes about the channel is read through these two functions, so one defect invalidated the evidence for six other entries at once. Three copies of the parser existed; one line-bounded copy now replaces them.

nodes.label: Applied — The State That Was Actually True
nodes.description: A fifth resolution, deliberately non-terminal: the fix is in the tree at a named commit and nobody independent has confirmed it. Ten entries moved to it, and a phase closure condition went red as a direct result.
nodes.rationale: The independent-verifier field was requested, adopted in name, and then defaulted to a receipt state. Recording ten honest applied rows costs a red condition; recording ten unearned verified rows costs the meaning of the word, and nothing could have told them apart afterwards.

nodes.label: A Later Phase's Blocker Must Not Fail an Earlier Phase's Boundary
nodes.description: The closure gate required every entry in the channel to be terminal whenever any phase closed. The rule had always said entries raised against that phase; the check had no field to read that from until the phase field became mandatory.
nodes.rationale: An entry with no legible phase used to vanish from every gate silently, so a real blocker could disappear from the phase it blocks. Both halves are negative-tested: a later-phase entry does not fail the earlier boundary, and a same-phase entry does.

nodes.label: A Check Written to Stop False Greens Had One
nodes.description: The first version shelled out to a text filter absent on this platform and swallowed the error, reported one canonical file for every count including zero, and never asserted the canonical file existed. The rewrite then passed with that file deleted, because the index still listed it.
nodes.rationale: The fourth defect was caught by the check's own negative fixture rather than by review, which is the entire argument for writing fixtures before believing a check. Discovery failing must never be indistinguishable from discovering nothing.

nodes.label: A Skipped Job Is an Accepted Required Check
nodes.description: The compatibility job that supplies the new required status context depends on the real verification job without an always-run condition, so it is skipped rather than failed when verification fails, and its only step echoes a fixed string.
nodes.rationale: A skipped context is acceptable to the protected branch, so the new context can report green while typecheck, lint, tests and the consistency suite have not passed. The condition blocks making it required rather than blocking the commit, because the dangerous act is the settings change.

nodes.label: The Dominant Defect Source Is Its Own Corrections
nodes.description: One review recorded six of eight findings as defects introduced by the passes correcting the previous ten. The next recorded seven of eleven the same way, and the pass repairing those findings shipped two more, one of them a false green inside a check written to stop false greens.
nodes.rationale: No control is proposed, because a check that fires on a correction introducing something fires on the normal case. What actually caught these was an independent lane reviewing the repair and negative fixtures written before the check was believed.
